Lemon Herb Chicken and Rice
Source: https://recipes.example.invalid/lemon-herb-chicken-and-rice
Makes 4 servings

Ingredients
- 600 g chicken breast
- 1 cup jasmine rice
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lemon
- 3 cloves garlic
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 2 cups chicken stock

Method
1. Sear the chicken in oil until golden.
2. Add rice, garlic, stock, lemon and oregano.
3. Cover and simmer for 18 minutes.

Nutrition per serving: 470 calories, 41 g protein, 44 g carbohydrates, 12 g fat

Baked Mac and Cheese with Turkey
Source: https://recipes.example.invalid/baked-mac-and-cheese-with-turkey
Makes 6 servings

Ingredients
- 400 g elbow macaroni
- 500 g ground turkey
- 2 cups shredded cheddar
- 2 cups whole milk
- 3 tbsp butter
- 3 tbsp flour
- 1 tsp mustard powder

Method
1. Boil the macaroni.
2. Brown the turkey.
3. Make a roux with butter and flour, whisk in milk, melt in cheddar.
4. Combine and bake 20 minutes.

Nutrition per serving: 610 calories, 38 g protein, 52 g carbohydrates, 27 g fat

Sheet Pan Salmon and Sweet Potato
Source: https://recipes.example.invalid/sheet-pan-salmon-and-sweet-potato
Makes 4 servings

Ingredients
- 4 salmon fillets (150 g each)
- 700 g sweet potato
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 300 g green beans
- 1 tbsp maple syrup

Method
1. Heat the oven to 220 C.
2. Roast the sweet potato 15 minutes.
3. Add salmon and green beans, roast 12 minutes more.

Nutrition per serving: 520 calories, 36 g protein, 41 g carbohydrates, 24 g fat

Slow Cooker Beef Chili
Source: https://recipes.example.invalid/slow-cooker-beef-chili
Makes 8 servings

Ingredients
- 1 kg lean ground beef
- 2 cans kidney beans
- 1 can diced tomatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 tbsp chili powder
- 1 tsp cumin
- 2 cups beef stock

Method
1. Brown the beef and onion.
2. Combine everything in the slow cooker.
3. Cook on low for 7 hours.

Nutrition (whole recipe): 3,200 calories, 256 g protein, 280 g carbohydrates, 120 g fat

Creamy Tuscan Chicken
Source: https://recipes.example.invalid/creamy-tuscan-chicken
Makes 4 servings

Ingredients
- 700 g chicken breast
- 1 cup heavy cream
- 1/2 cup grated parmesan
- 1 cup sun-dried tomatoes
- 2 cups baby spinach
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 3 cloves garlic

Method
1. Sear the chicken and set aside.
2. Simmer garlic, cream, parmesan and tomatoes.
3. Return the chicken, wilt in the spinach.

Nutrition per serving: 560 calories, 45 g protein, 12 g carbohydrates, 36 g fat
